The CLI streams progress in real time and returns a report URL when complete. Review output includes findings, severity, and provenance so you can understand both what changed and why the review reached its recommendation.\n\n## Self-hosting\n\nNimbus supports hosted usage and self-hosted worker deployments. Register your repo to your Nimbus account:\n\n```bash\nnimbus repo register --repo owner/repo\n```\n\n2. Add your GitHub PAT to repository secrets:\n   - Secret name: `REVIEW_CONTEXT_GITHUB_TOKEN`\n   - Location: Repo Settings -> Secrets and variables -> Actions\n\n3. The CLI streams progress in real time and returns a report URL when complete. Review output includes findings, severity, and provenance so you can understand both what changed and why the review reached its recommendation.\n\n## Self-hosting\n\nNimbus supports hosted usage and self-hosted worker deployments.
